title: Changelog - January 2017 | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Changelog - January 2017 Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093660 New Features: Font-Awesome Feature has been updated to version 4.7. Check the list on new Icons here . Security Update in the Sign Up pages. Clone Membership Level Functionality. External Developers can Add an Admin Menu Link to Custom Plugins. For further information click here . Enhancements / Fixes: Bug fixes through the New Leads Module, New Reviews Module and Google Location System. In summary more than 15+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
